newsitem.title: NORWAY: Aker RGI to raise stake in fish unit.
newsitem.headline: Aker RGI to raise stake in fish unit.

text.p: Norwegian holding company Aker RGI ASA said on Monday it was increasing its stake in Norway Seafoods by 11.99 percent in accordance with an earlier options agreement with Tiger Management LLC.
The stake is equivalent to 8,402,175 shares in the world's largest white fish fishing and processing concern. Aker RGI already holds 54.7 percent of the group.
Tiger Management holds the shares on behalf of the Tiger, Puma and The Jaguar Fund, a statement from Aker RGI said.
According to the options agreement Aker RGI will buy the shareholding at 50 crowns per share. The company said it had no plans to sell the stock.
